content.text:
The board is back up and serving its existing data (3 items preserved from the mounted volume).

**Root cause:** the `bench-board-image` package had never been built and had no running process at all — the kitbash Package existed with its manifest/code, but nothing had ever deployed it, so the URL had nothing to answer.

**Fix:** built the package (`pkg_build`) and started it (`proc_run`). It's now running at `https://bench-board-image.bench-20260919-2334.kitbash.zyx.tw`, serving the homepage, `/api/items`, and `/healthz` — all returning 200, with the previously-stored board items intact from the mounted `/data` volume.
